comment: M4 enemy roster (GD-01..29). types = behaviour identity; bands = AUTHORED per-band stat tables (GD-23, no formulas): hp / damage per hit / speed in blocks-per-sec / aggro radius in blocks. An enemy only seeds in bands it has a row for. drops are the light kind (GD-24): cloth and scrap bits from zombies, meat from fish.

seeding.comment: Density doubled 2026-09-05 (user request) over the GD-27 baseline: a dry wing-floor now rolls 0..3 zombies (weights index = count, ~1.7 expected, was ~0.85), flooded Dark/Crush wings roll a Drowned at 0.8 (was 0.4), and open-water spacings are halved. Spacings are cell ranges walked along OPEN WATER columns only (gaps + ocean margins), not the whole world width. Pity timer per wing: every quiet floor adds wing_pity_boost to the next floor's chance of at least one spawn, and after wing_pity_floors quiet floors the next is guaranteed (when the floor can hold anything). T0 rooftops (2026-09-06): after dark every player standing on an open roof, outside a sealed room of their own, draws roof_night_max spawns from roof_night_types onto roof tops roof_night_min..max_blocks away (same cadence as the night floaters); they clear at dawn. Predator fish (2026-09-06): flooded Shallows/Cold wing-floors roll wing_fish_chance for one fish drawn from that band's wing_fish_weights (so those floors are no longer quiet), and each fish type is also scattered along open water in its bands at pred_fish_spacing (tropical: shallows; catfish: shallows+cold; barracuda: cold).

types.name: Prowler
types.desc: T0 rooftop night stalker (placeholder until the bestiary grid names the real ones): fast, thin, hunts the open roofs after dark and vanishes at dawn; cannot break a player's walls.

types.name: Tropical Fish
types.desc: Bright reef fish gone feral in the flooded floors: nippy, fast, dies to a knife. The easy one.

types.name: Catfish
types.desc: A fat bottom-feeder that has learned to bite: slow, tough, hunts by the whiskers along flooded floors.

types.name: Barracuda
types.desc: A silver torpedo with a mouth of needles: the fastest thing in the water and the hardest of the three to kill. Its bite bleeds.

types.name: Rooftop Rat
types.desc: Large brown rat with patchy oily fur, oversized teeth, and a long scarred tail - bites the player. Lives: Rooftops around vents, machinery, and maintenance areas. Quickly changes direction when approached

types.name: Ironback Roach
types.desc: Oversized black cockroach with a thick dark shell and unusually heavy abdomen - claws the player. Lives: Rooftops beneath machinery and inside maintenance structures. Hard shell reduces incoming damage slightly

types.name: Scrap Mantis
types.desc: Large green-brown praying mantis with oversized forelegs and bits of metal debris caught in its body - slashes the player with its forelegs. Lives: Rooftops around piles of scrap and industrial equipment. Briefly freezes before making a fast attack

types.name: Cable Leech
types.desc: Pale elongated leech with a circular mouth and tiny electrical burns along its body - latches onto the player and drains them. Lives: Rooftop electrical cabinets, conduits, and cable runs. Can remain motionless until the player gets close

types.name: Rebar Spider
types.desc: Large gray spider with long thin legs and a pale abdomen covered in dark markings - bites the player. Lives: Scaffolding, exposed rebar, and unfinished floors. Moves quickly across vertical surfaces

types.name: Dust Beetle
types.desc: Large beetle with a dusty gray shell and thick armored legs - charges into the player. Lives: Concrete piles, rubble, and unfinished rooftop floors. Charges in a straight line when attacking

types.name: Crane Rat
types.desc: Lean gray rat with oversized paws, a long balancing tail, and patches of missing fur - bites the player. Lives: Cranes, scaffolding, cables, and elevated construction platforms. Can cross narrow ledges without slowing down

types.name: Brickback
types.desc: Stocky armadillo-like creature with a rough reddish shell resembling chipped brick - rams the player. Lives: Rubble piles and sheltered areas of unfinished buildings. Tucks into its shell when heavily damaged

types.name: Office Crow
types.desc: Large black crow with an unusually long beak and patches of gray feathers - pecks the player. Lives: Skyscraper rooftops, signs, and window ledges. Can quickly fly over small obstacles

types.name: Glasswing Bat
types.desc: Pale bat with thin translucent wings and oversized ears - bites the player. Lives: Skyscraper roofs and dark spaces around office towers. Difficult to see against the night sky

types.name: Window Gecko
types.desc: Pale blue-gray gecko with oversized adhesive feet and large reflective eyes - bites the player. Lives: Glass windows, ledges, and exterior walls. Can climb vertical glass surfaces

types.name: Pigeon Swarm
types.desc: Dense flock of oversized gray pigeons with swollen eyes and ragged feathers - swarm attacks the player with pecks and wing strikes. Lives: Rooftops, signs, balconies, and building ledges. Temporarily scatters when damaged

types.name: Poison Frog
types.desc: Green tree frog with dark green legs - jumps onto the player. Lives: Roofs (day and night).

types.name: Chimney Bat
types.desc: Large brown bat with oversized claws and torn ears - bites the player. Lives: Chimneys, attic vents, and rooftop structures. Can hide inside chimneys until disturbed

types.name: Gutter Snake
types.desc: Thin dark snake with an unusually long body and pale eyes - bites the player. Lives: Gutters, drains, roof gardens, and sheltered roof spaces. Can remain hidden inside narrow spaces

types.name: Roof Cat
types.desc: Lean feral cat with oversized claws, patchy fur, and glowing yellow eyes - slashes the player. Lives: Residential rooftops, patios, and abandoned homes. Can leap across narrow gaps

types.name: Grease Rat
types.desc: Large fat rat with greasy black fur and a swollen belly - bites the player. Lives: Restaurant rooftops, exhaust systems, and dumpsters. Slow but difficult to stagger

types.name: Sign Bat
types.desc: Dark brown bat with a broad wingspan and bright reflective eyes - dives at the player. Lives: Inside large rooftop signs and illuminated storefront signs. Begins combat from above when disturbed

types.name: Dumpster Raccoon
types.desc: Oversized raccoon with thick forearms, dirty gray fur, and a damaged black mask marking - swipes the player. Lives: Dumpsters, restaurant roofs, and commercial waste areas. Becomes more aggressive when damaged

types.name: Grease Mantis
types.desc: Large brown praying mantis with greasy black patches and elongated forelegs - slashes the player. Lives: Restaurant exhaust vents and rooftop kitchen equipment. Remains motionless near exhaust vents

types.name: Sewer Rat
types.desc: Large scarred gray rat with missing patches of fur and a blunt tail - bites the player. Lives: Municipal drains, maintenance access points, and civic rooftops. Can emerge suddenly from drains

types.name: Bell Bat
types.desc: Dark gray bat with oversized ears and a pale face - bites the player. Lives: Civic towers, bell towers, and dark rooftop structures. Uses sound to locate nearby movement

types.name: Statue Pigeon
types.desc: Large gray pigeon with patches of hard stone-like skin across its wings and breast - pecks the player. Lives: Monuments, statues, courthouses, and public buildings. Hard patches make it slightly resistant to damage

types.name: Roof Lizard
types.desc: Dark green lizard with unusually long legs, a narrow head, and bright yellow eyes - bites the player. Lives: Public building roofs, vents, and sun-warmed surfaces. Very fast over short distances

types.name: Boiler Hyena
types.desc: Lean gray hyena with patchy fur, oversized jaws, and dark stains around its mouth - bites the player. Lives: Dry industrial floors around boiler rooms, machinery, and maintenance corridors. Lets out a loud cackle that can alert nearby monsters

types.name: Boiler Scorpion
types.desc: Large dark scorpion with heat-scarred armor, thick pincers, and a swollen tail - stings the player with its tail. Lives: Boiler rooms, warm machinery spaces, and dry industrial floors. Poisoned sting briefly slows the player

types.name: Furnace Centipede
types.desc: Long reddish-brown centipede with dozens of thin legs and a dark armored head - bites the player. Lives: Warm ventilation ducts, furnaces, and machinery spaces. Can squeeze through narrow gaps

types.name: Oil Slug
types.desc: Large black slug with a glossy oily body and pale feelers - covers the player in corrosive slime. Lives: Oil-stained floors, drainage channels, and dark machinery rooms. Leaves a slippery trail behind itself

types.name: Hammerhead Mole
types.desc: Large blind mole with an oversized flattened skull, thick claws, and gray dusty fur - charges into the player. Lives: Unfinished floors, rubble piles, and areas beneath construction debris. Can emerge suddenly from rubble

types.name: Rebar Tick
types.desc: Oversized dark tick with thin rigid legs and a hard segmented body - latches onto the player. Lives: Scaffolding, exposed rebar, and dark construction cavities. Latches onto the player briefly, slowing movement

types.name: Scaffold Goat
types.desc: Thin feral goat with unusually long legs, oversized horns, and patchy gray fur - headbutts the player. Lives: Scaffolding, unfinished floors, and elevated construction platforms. Can cross narrow beams without slowing down

types.name: Concrete Tortoise
types.desc: Heavy tortoise with a cracked shell coated in concrete dust and gray mineral growth - rams the player. Lives: Rubble piles, concrete floors, and sheltered construction areas. Resistant to knockback

types.name: Window Cicada
types.desc: Large gray cicada with translucent wings and oversized red eyes - dives into the player. Lives: Office exteriors, ventilation openings, and illuminated windows. Produces a loud buzzing sound that briefly disrupts nearby enemies

types.name: Suit Owl
types.desc: Large dark owl with narrow black feather markings resembling a suit and unusually long talons - dives and claws the player. Lives: Office towers, rooftop ledges, and dark maintenance floors. Silent movement makes it difficult to detect before attacking

types.name: Glass Squirrel
types.desc: Hairless gray squirrel with translucent patches of skin and oversized black eyes - bites the player. Lives: Window ledges, office planters, and rooftop gardens. Moves erratically when threatened

types.name: Elevator Wasp
types.desc: Large black and yellow wasp with an elongated abdomen and unusually long stinger - stings the player. Lives: Elevator shafts, mechanical rooms, and office ventilation systems. Can attack from above and retreat quickly

types.name: Attic Weasel
types.desc: Long thin weasel with pale fur, oversized teeth, and dark eyes - bites the player. Lives: Attics, wall cavities, insulation, and abandoned upper floors. Can move through narrow openings

types.name: Mold Rabbit
types.desc: Large white rabbit with patchy fur and pale fungal growth around its ears and back - kicks the player. Lives: Abandoned apartments, roof gardens, and dry living spaces. Makes sudden long jumps when attacked

types.name: Chimney Possum
types.desc: Large gray possum with swollen eyes, long claws, and a partially hairless tail - claws the player. Lives: Chimneys, attics, and abandoned residential interiors. Plays dead briefly when severely injured

types.name: Ceiling Mouse
types.desc: Tiny pale mouse with oversized ears and long thin limbs - bites the player. Lives: Ceiling cavities, walls, and abandoned apartments. Very difficult to hit while moving through ceiling gaps

types.name: Butcher Dog
types.desc: Large feral dog with powerful shoulders, an enlarged jaw, and patchy dirty fur - bites the player. Lives: Abandoned restaurants, food storage areas, and commercial kitchens. Becomes more aggressive below half health

types.name: Freezer Cricket
types.desc: Large pale cricket with long antennae and an unusually thick abdomen - leaps into the player. Lives: Cold storage areas, restaurant equipment rooms, and food warehouses. Can leap over obstacles

types.name: Shopping Crab
types.desc: Small red crab with oversized claws and a shell covered in scratches - snaps its claws at the player. Lives: Abandoned shopping areas, food courts, and storage rooms. Moves sideways at high speed

types.name: Meat Fly
types.desc: Oversized blue-black fly with a swollen abdomen and cloudy compound eyes - lands on the player and bites. Lives: Food storage rooms, restaurants, garbage areas, and butcher shops. Moves unpredictably and can quickly change direction

types.name: Police Horse
types.desc: Large thin horse with an unusually muscular neck, cloudy eyes, and patchy coat - kicks the player. Lives: Police facilities, public courtyards, and abandoned civic buildings. Charges directly toward the player from a distance

types.name: Archive Silverfish
types.desc: Large silverfish with an elongated metallic body and long trailing bristles - bites the player. Lives: Archives, libraries, records rooms, and document storage. Can hide beneath loose papers and debris

types.name: Firehouse Salamander
types.desc: Large black salamander with bright red markings and unusually thick limbs - bites the player. Lives: Fire stations, equipment rooms, and damp utility areas. Produces a mildly irritating skin secretion

types.name: Chapel Snail
types.desc: Large pale snail with a thick spiral shell covered in faint mineral deposits - headbutts the player. Lives: Churches, chapels, public monuments, and sheltered civic buildings. Leaves a sticky trail that slows movement

types.name: Drain Eel
types.desc: Thin dark eel with pale eyes and a long flexible body - bites the player. Lives: Newly flooded drains, pipes, and shallow water channels. Can hide inside flooded pipes

types.name: Water Strider
types.desc: Oversized dark water strider with extremely long thin legs - jumps onto the player. Lives: Shallow flooded floors and pools of standing water. Moves rapidly across the surface of water

types.name: Minnow School
types.desc: Dense school of small silver fish with oversized mouths and dark swollen eyes - swarm bites the player. Lives: Shallow flooded rooms, pools, and submerged corridors. Moves as a group and surrounds nearby targets

types.name: Mudskipper
types.desc: Large brown mudskipper with oversized eyes, thick fins, and muscular front fins - bites the player. Lives: Shallow flooded floors, muddy debris, and waterlogged rooms. Can move between water and dry surfaces

types.name: Rust-Crested Eel
types.desc: Elongated metallic-grey eel with sharp rusted crests along its spine - shocks and bites the player. Lives: Flooded factory floors (0-92 ft). inflicts minor shock damage over time

types.name: Sludge Crab
types.desc: Bulky crab coated in dark oily sludge and pipe fragments - pinches with heavy claws. Lives: Submerged oil vats and pipes (0-92 ft). high defense, leaves oily slick

types.name: Boiler Lamprey
types.desc: Thick leech-like fish with glowing red heated throat rings - latches on and drains health. Lives: Boiler room ruins (0-92 ft). heals slightly on damage dealt

types.name: Grease Viper
types.desc: Slick black sea snake dripping slick chemical residue - strikes swiftly with venomous fangs. Lives: Submerged engine hulls (0-92 ft). poison attack

types.name: Rebar Snapping Turtle
types.desc: Massive snapping turtle with rebar fused into its shell and jaw - snaps with heavy rebar jaws. Lives: Flooded scaffolding debris (0-92 ft). reflects partial physical damage

types.name: Concrete Ray
types.desc: Flat grey stingray disguised as a slab of cracked concrete - whips tail and buries player in silt. Lives: Submerged concrete foundations (0-92 ft). camouflages against floors

types.name: Scaffolding Barnacle
types.desc: Colony of jagged barnacles attached to corroded iron structural beams - spits sharp calcified shell shards. Lives: Steel girders underwater (0-92 ft). stationary, ranged burst shooter

types.name: Silt-Dredger Catfish
types.desc: Armored catfish with heavy stone-like scales and long sensory barbels - rams player and stirs up blinding mud. Lives: Flooded pit foundations (0-92 ft). blinds player temporarily on charge

types.name: Silt Stalker
types.desc: Translucent predatory fish with long dark stealth-like tentacles - ambushes from shadows and constricts. Lives: Submerged office corridors (0-92 ft). turns semi-invisible when stationary

types.name: Document Squid
types.desc: Pale squid draped in shredded waterlogged documents and office supplies - shoots ink infused with pulp shreds. Lives: Flooded file storage vaults (0-92 ft). blinds target with ink cloud

types.name: Led Anglerfish
types.desc: Vicious deep-sea anglerfish with a flickering digital sign bulb stalk - blinds with bright flash then bites. Lives: Sunken lobby spaces (0-92 ft). stuns targets in range with light flash

types.name: Vault Moray
types.desc: Dark sleek eel nesting inside rusted safe deposit boxes - strikes out from metal crevices. Lives: Flooded bank vaults (0-92 ft). high critical hit chance from hiding

types.name: Barnacle Leech
types.desc: Large segmented leech covered in sharp shell-like barnacle plating - attaches and drains blood. Lives: Flooded living rooms and roofs (0-92 ft). latches on reducing movement speed

types.name: Submerged Hound
types.desc: Feral hound with webbed paws, slick skin, and external gills - pounces and bites with webbed jaws. Lives: Sunken apartment complexes (0-92 ft). fast swimmer, chases aggressively

types.name: Gutter Pike
types.desc: Long narrow predatory fish with razor-sharp teeth protruding outward - thrusts forward with needle teeth. Lives: Flooded drainage and gutters (0-92 ft). fast burst forward attack

types.name: Aquarium Betta
types.desc: Overgrown vibrant red betta fish with sharp serrated tail fins - slaps with razor-sharp fins. Lives: Flooded home aquariums and bedrooms (0-92 ft). aggressive territory defense bonus

types.name: Neon Jellyfish
types.desc: Glowing neon-colored jellyfish pulsing with static charge - stings with electrified tentacles. Lives: Submerged storefront windows (0-92 ft). shocks on physical contact

types.name: Display-Case Mantis Shrimp
types.desc: Colorful mantis shrimp carrying fragments of shattered glass as armor - delivers explosive cavitation punch. Lives: Flooded luxury displays (0-92 ft). high armor piercing punch

types.name: Cart Skeleton Crabs
types.desc: Swarm of small skeleton crabs clinging to wire shopping carts - swarms and pinches in unison. Lives: Submerged supermarket aisles (0-92 ft). multi-target swarming attacks

types.name: Billboard Stingray
types.desc: Wide flat ray with glowing marketing-patterned spots across its back - glides over player and whips tail. Lives: Flooded outdoor plazas (0-92 ft). sweeping area melee attack

types.name: Drain Pipe Octopus
types.desc: Dark mottled octopus emerging from a heavy cast-iron drain pipe - grabs with suckers and pulls into pipes. Lives: Drainage systems and main pipes (0-92 ft). pulls player closer on hit

types.name: Sewer Gator
types.desc: Pale, blind alligator encrusted with sewer grime and iron rust - thrashes and bites viciously. Lives: Flooded subway lines and sewers (0-92 ft). death roll inflicts heavy bleed

types.name: Culvert Hagfish
types.desc: Slimy eel-like hagfish wrapped around rusted civil plumbing - secretes thick slime and bites. Lives: Flooded culverts and water tunnels (0-92 ft). slime coat reduces incoming physical damage

types.name: Valve Urchin
types.desc: Spiky sea urchin attached to a rusty valve handle - shoots sharp spines in all directions. Lives: Submerged water treatment valves (0-92 ft). 360-degree spine burst attack

types.name: Reef Shark
types.desc: Grey sleek reef shark with sharp serrated fins - swift direct bite. Lives: Open shallow sea (0-92 ft). gains speed when player is injured

types.name: Depth Barracuda
types.desc: Silver long-bodied barracuda with glowing yellow eyes - charges at high speed with lower jaw strike. Lives: Sunken open channels (0-92 ft). high speed charge

types.name: Swarm Anchovy
types.desc: Dense shimmering silver bait ball of hundreds of tiny fish - swarms and suffocates target. Lives: Open water currents (0-92 ft). hard to hit with single-target attacks

types.name: Chasm Lionfish
types.desc: Ornate red and white lionfish with long fan-like poisonous spines - fires venomous fin spines. Lives: Submerged chasm edges (0-92 ft). venomous projectile attack
